notes: variance.json covers all 50 tasks (frozen schema, all keys present, verified programmatically). 7/50 excluded on detection_rate<0.5 (bottle-cleaning 0.036, fabric-cutting-machine 0.482, fabric-cutting-scissor 0.453, lathe-machine-operation 0.348, plaster-ceiling-tile 0.168, processing-fabric-cut 0.391, processing-fabric-spread 0.322) -- same det1 rule/threshold as pipeline/segment.py, cross-checked axle-shaft-cutting's det1 against web/public/data/corpus.json and it matches to 4 decimals. All 43 non-excluded tasks used method=landmarks; IMU gyro_rms fallback path is implemented and wired (triggers if <4 clips yield a usable landmark series) but was never needed on this corpus. Feature vector per detected frame: (h0_cx, h0_cy, h0_aperture, h0_speed) read directly from extract.py's parquet columns (no re-derivation of landmarks), z-scored within each clip before DTW (dtaidistance dtw_ndim, installed via uv pip install -- chose dtaidistance over tslearn). k=2 clustering: scipy hierarchical average-linkage on the precomputed DTW matrix. silhouette_k2 via sklearn (metric=precomputed). perm_p: 1000 permutations, seed=42, fixed and reproducible (fraction of shuffled-label silhouettes >= real). Confound check: adjusted_rand_score(labels, group_ids) >= 0.30 => confounded; ALSO treat n_families<2 or n_cameras<2 as confounded=True for that axis (a single family/camera means there is no cross-worker/cross-mount variation for the split to possibly reflect, so per PLAN_v2's own landmine 'single-recording-family tasks CANNOT support cross-worker variance claims' it must count as unusable for tier=ask even though ARI is undefined there) -- this is a deliberate strengthening of the literal spec found while sanity-checking against PLAN_v2's list; documented in compute.py's confound_flag() docstring. IMPORTANT FINDING for B/F: of the 21 tasks that are both non-excluded and non-confounded, NOT ONE has perm_p<=0.05 (best cases: garment-inside-out sil=0.152 p=0.113, fabric-layering sil=0.124 p=0.109, garment-carton-packing sil=0.122 p=0.115). Every task with perm_p<=0.05 in the whole corpus is confounded on family and/or camera (e.g. metal-grinding p=0.032 fam=T cam=T, garment-back-panel-attachment p=0.010 cam=T). So per B's frozen spec (deconfounded AND perm_p<=0.05 => tier=ask), zero of the 50 tasks currently qualify for a real tier=ask -- B/F should expect decide.py to fall through to tier=act for every matched, non-confounded task, and BEAT 2 has no statistically-defensible 'ask' task under the current threshold. This is a real corpus property (n=6-9 per task, camera-mount signal dominates), not a bug; flagging per protocol so the orchestrator decides whether to adjust BEAT 2 framing/threshold rather than agents renegotiating it themselves. PLAN_v2 clean-list cross-check: DISAGREEMENT (expected and explainable, not an error) -- plan-only 7: belly-band-assembly, binding-pre-fold-stitching, fabric-cutting-machine, garment-back-panel-attachment, garment-stitching-overlock, processing-fabric-cut, processing-fabric-spread (all either fail detection_rate<0.5 or genuinely show camera/family leakage under actual DTW clustering that the metadata-only heuristic couldn't see); computed-only 7: cnc-machine-operation, drilling, garment-hanger-place, garment-tag-attachment, notebook-cover-assembly, panel-fitting-placement, register-ring-binding (these fail the metadata heuristic's clip_count>=8 or diversity_warning==[] filters but pass the real confound test -- the metadata proxy is coarser than actual clustering). Both computed and plan clean sets happen to total 21 by coincidence, membership differs by 7/21. Full detail and per-task numbers in variance/results/ranking.txt. No files written outside variance/ and coordination/status/.
